title: Record a mechanism and measure for OLY-B-A1-02 in docs/spec.toml
summary: The living strategy view already exists (`athena strategy`, crates/athena-cli/src/strategy.rs, docs/design/strategy-view.md). Point OLY-B-A1-02 at it with owner Athena and a "status: not shown" measure naming the test. Add a test that fails if the view is stale or the spec entry loses its mechanism.

defaults_applied.how: New test plus cargo test, clippy and fmt criteria.
Criteria run the strategy test against the real files.
Reuses the existing strategy module; builds nothing new.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: Sri reads the strategy view at any time; the verifier checks the spec entry and test.

Code survey: read crates/athena-cli/src/strategy.rs (run, render, parse_map, parse_goals, drift, existing test strategy_view_table_matches_the_map), crates/athena-cli/src/commands.rs strategy(), main.rs Command::Strategy; xtask/tests/spec.rs validates spec fields. No new record or data file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not affected.
Existing code: crates/athena-cli/src/strategy.rs, docs/design/strategy-view.md and docs/design/requirements-map.md are reused and extended, not created.

The measure uses `status: not shown` because I did not confirm that STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs has a strategy label; the producer should check and use a label if one fits.
No athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow change is needed; no refusal rule is added.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-A1-02 has a mechanism other than "none" that names `athena strategy` and crates/athena-cli/src/strategy.rs, owner "Athena", and a measure ending in `status: not shown` that names the test which shows it.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli strategy`: a new test reads docs/spec.toml and asserts OLY-B-A1-02's mechanism names an existing path (strategy.rs) and that `athena strategy` over the real map and view reports no errors; it fails with mechanism "none" and passes with the change.
Run `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`: every active requirement still has mechanism, owner and measure, and it passes.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` all pass.
Outcome check: Sri can run `athena strategy` and read docs/design/strategy-view.md to see goals, coverage and not-covered rows; the test is derived from that real output, not a stand-in.

out_of_scope: Changing the strategy view's content or format beyond what the test needs
Adding new status labels to athena status
departures: Small change because the mechanism already exists; cost and time sit a little below the reference.
